status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-cart-east, in Chapters V, VI and IX (on the web in Chapters V and VI only)
use: The battle's abandoned supply cart (the field object 'stores') in the eastern battles, in every state; the load stands on its bed while the supplies are still to be recovered.

generator.prompt: An abandoned provincial supply cart of Roman Syria: a sturdy two-wheeled cart with two solid wooden disc wheels made of three planks each, a deep open box bed of pale planks with painted side boards in faded red and ochre, and a single draught pole with a short yoke bar resting on the ground in front; the bed is empty. About two and a half metres long including the pole and one and a half metres wide. Pale sun-bleached wood, faded paint and dark iron. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the battles in the desktop build at High
review.notes: A two-wheeled cart with a pale plank bed, faded red side boards and a long single pole. Its wheels came spoked, not the solid disc wheels asked for; accepted, since the cart reads as a different, eastern cart beside the Roman one. 3.33 m long with its pole at 1.2 m high.
